question.text: Capital gains on equity MF (holding > 12 months) post Jul 2024:

explanation.text: The Logic: Post Jul 2024 LTCG on equity: 12.5% above Rs. 1.25 lakh annual threshold (across all equity). The Trap: Old rate (10%) superseded. Cross-Exam Context: Topic 10. Manager's Pro-Tip: Aggregate LTCG across MFs and direct equity for the Rs. 1.25 lakh threshold.
